findings.reason: the section must either add the cold audit and discovery medians to the completion floor or exempt them in the done-when, since the ambiguity decides whether a partial re-measure closes §6 or is redispatched.
findings.text: the done-when's first clause requires "the cold and warm medians of roadmap, audit and discovery" in the log, but the completion floor protects only "both arms' cold roadmaps and both arms' warm roadmap and audit" and the section states cold audit and both discovery medians "carry no target"; on the hour-exhaustion path the run "records the medians of every read that did finish and names each read that did not", so a run §6 calls complete can omit exactly the cold audit and cold discovery medians the done-when demands, leaving a worker unable to tell whether such a partial run satisfies §6

findings.reason: the floor's operative list is explicit and the two extra base warm reads are the comparison figures the section already explains, so the gloss misleads no worker about what to run.
findings.text: the sentence "Those reads are the control and all three targets" describes the six floor reads (both arms' cold roadmaps plus both arms' warm roadmap and audit) as the control and three targets, but the control is the base arm's cold roadmap and the three targets are the head arm's cold roadmap and warm roadmap and audit — four reads — so the sentence's count does not match the list it glosses
